thread:
elaine: Heads-up: external pen test scheduled week of Jun 9. We want a DRY-RUN in staging next Wed (2026-06-02) 09:00-12:00 PT to validate evidence handoff. Need RBAC + KMS handoff plan and an evidence checklist. Who can own which piece?

dmitri: I can drive RBAC changes. Will need a clear list of temporary roles, exact resource ARNs, and TTL policy.

elaine: Great. @dmitri can you propose role names and least-privilege scope? Also we need KMS key access pattern: presigned uploads vs server-side wrap? cc @maria for audit logs retention and export.

maria: Audit logs: we should export CloudTrail + S3 object events to the evidence bucket. Retention for PT evidence = 12 months. I will coordinate the export with @ops-oncall.

sec-bot: FYI previous PT flagged broad service-account permissions (see SI-423). Recommend ephemeral roles + scoped S3 prefix.

josh: For dry-run I prefer ephemeral roles via short-lived certs. We have a script:
```bash
./tools/ephemeral_role_grant.sh --role pt-assessor --ttl 6h --user $ASSESSOR
```
That flows well with presigned uploads.

dmitri: Proposed roles: pt-assessor-readonly, pt-assessor-netdiag, pt-audit-reader. Scope: single staging VPC, limited EC2 describe, and s3 arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-staging/* for evidence. I'll draft the IAM JSON and PR.

josh: For KMS, create a dedicated key `pt-evidence-key` with policy allowing wrap/unwrap by ops service account + auditors. We should use envelope encryption for presigned uploads (KMS data key).

maria: KMS policy note: ops principal + auditors must be in key policy. Also disable automatic rotation during the evidence window to avoid extra noise. Ensure key usage logs are included in evidence bundle.

samir: Timeline check: Dry-run 2026-06-02 09:00-12:00 PT. External assessment window 2026-06-09 to 06-13. Request retest block two weeks after fixes — can we reserve 2026-06-23 to 06-24?

ops-oncall: I can create the S3 prefix + lifecycle rule. Need IAM JSON from @dmitri and the KMS key ARN. Will add a 30d lock/lifecycle for evidence objects.

elaine: Action items:
- @dmitri: post IAM JSON + CLI to create ephemeral roles by EOD today
- @josh: KMS key policy + envelope example + helper script
- @maria: audit export runbook + retention confirmation
- @ops-oncall: create S3 prefix + pre-signed URL flow
- @samir: calendar invites for dry-run and retest blocks
We will use #release-war-room for dry-run on-call.

dmitri: Assigning to me. Draft IAM snippet (will refine in PR):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-staging/*",
      "Condition": {"DateLessThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-06-02T18:00:00Z"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

maria: Also enable CloudTrail management + data events, and S3 object-level logging (Server access logging) for the evidence bucket. We'll include a small script to pull relevant log slices for assessors.

josh: KMS example payload for ops: 
```json
{"KeyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-evidence-key","KeyPolicy":"<ops and auditors principals>","Description":"Key for PT evidence envelope encryption"}
```
I'll add the envelope helper to `tools/` and document usage.

sec-bot: Remediation tracker suggestion: create a GH issue with label `pt-remediation` and a simple workflow to triage/assign. Template: summary, vuln id, owner, ETA, evidence link. Tie to alerts in #incidents when severity >= P1.

samir: Calendar invites sent for dry-run and I tentatively reserved 2026-06-23 to 06-24 for retest. External assessor accepted dry-run invite.

ops-oncall: S3 prefix created: `s3://pt-evidence-staging/2026-06-dryrun/`. Pre-signed upload endpoint: https://upload.redwood.company/pt-preupload — it uses envelope keys + KMS. Bucket policy limits uploads to ephemeral role ARNs.

dmitri: Pushed IAM PR with TTL and tagging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1324. Roles will be tagged `pt-window:2026-06-02`. Example grant command: `./infra grant-role --role pt-assessor-readonly --assessor-id QA123`.

ops-oncall: KMS key created. ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcdef01-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789. Bucket policy and key policy attached.

samir: External assessor confirmed dry-run. All set from scheduling side.

elaine: Quick dry-run checklist for tomorrow: 
- ephemeral roles created and tested
- KMS key + envelope workflow validated
- S3 prefix + presign endpoint up and tested
- CloudTrail + server access logs exported to evidence prefix
- on-call in #release-war-room for triage
If anything blocks overnight, ping me directly.

josh: :thumbsup: I'll push the envelope helper and usage example to the PR.

maria: I'll produce a one-pager for assessors: how to download logs, expected artifact names, where to upload findings.

ops-oncall: After the dry-run I will revoke ephemeral creds and post a confirmation here with timestamps.

dmitri: Roles created and validated in staging. IAM JSON posted in PR. I also added an automated revoke hook to run after the window.

ops-oncall: Confirmed: S3 policy updated and KMS key active. Pre-signed uploads accepted in a quick smoke test.

samir: Dry-run accepted by assessor and scheduled.

elaine: Nice work everyone. After dry-run we'll capture lessons and fold changes into the PT playbook. Retest scheduling will reuse the same ephemeral + KMS flow. Closing thread for now — will re-open if blockers appear.
